programs.title: Holy Spider
programs.desc: Iran 2001, a journalist from Tehran dives into the most notorious suburbs of the holy city of Mashhad to investigate a series of feminicides. She soon finds out that the local authorities are in no hurry to solve the case. These crimes would be the work of a single man, who claims to purify the city of its sins, by attacking prostitutes at night.

programs.title: Monsieur Verdoux
programs.desc: Verdoux is an insignificant bank clerk who loses his job during the Great Depression. Soon, he devises a plan to marry old spinsters and murder them for their money.

programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: A look at the life and career of the Hollywood actor, whose roles in Jaws, All That Jazz and The French Connection catapulted him to stardom.

programs.title: The Boy And The Heron
programs.desc: Following his mother's untimely death, a young boy is left stunned when a heron informs him that his mother is still alive, which sets him on a wild and perilous journey in hopes of reuniting with her.

programs.title: Hating Alison Ashley
programs.desc: Classmates Erica Yurgen and Alison Ashley vie with each other to become the undisputed star of their class.

programs.title: Dancing At Lughnasa
programs.desc: A boy is raised by his mother and her four sisters in 1930s Ireland. The simple, ordered lives of these five women are thrown into turmoil by the appearance of their brother.
